messages:
Alex K: Quick heads-up — scheduling panel for Jordan Lee (SWE2) next Wed 11/12 10:30-11:30 PT. Needs: coding interview, system design, and general behavioral. Can folks confirm availability? :calendar:

Priya R: I’ve tentatively added the candidate to that slot and invited panelists. @Maya S you asked to own system design, right? I can swap if needed.

Maya S: Yep I can cover system design. Quick Q on rubric: do we want coding + design equal weight, or give design more for SWE2?

Sam T: I vote equal unless the hiring manager wants otherwise — coding is still a big signal at this level.

Ben L: I can do coding. One ask: can we standardize the coding rubric? Last time people used different scoring scales and it made debriefs messy.

Alex K: Good call. Proposed quick rubric for consistency (happy to iterate):
```
SystemDesign: 40
Coding: 40
Collaboration/Behavioral: 20
Scale each 1-5 and multiply by weight, round to nearest whole.
```
Would that work for hiring panel?

Priya R: That works for me — I’ll attach the rubric doc to the invite. I’ll also add a 10-min buffer at the end for debrief. :white_check_mark:

Maya S: Works. Tiny clarification: for SystemDesign, do we assess trade-offs + ops considerations as separate sub-scores or folded into the 1-5? I prefer having a short note field per candidate.

Alex K: Good idea — add a short "notes" textbox under each section in the doc. Keep scoring 1-5 but ask people to jot 1-2 bullets.

Ben L: Thumbs up. Also, can someone paste the coding prompt we'll use? Want to prep test harness quickly.

Sam T: I’ll dig up the last prompt we used and post here in 10. It's a medium-level arrays + sliding window problem, fair for SWE2.

recruiting-bot: Calendar invites created and shared with panelists. Candidate contact sent. Reminder set 24h before.

Priya R: Added interview packet + rubric link to the calendar invite. Everyone should see docs under the event now. Please review before EOD Tuesday.

Alex K: Thanks all — final ask: after interview, please fill scores within 2 hours. We’ll sync debrief at 11:40 so we can make a call same day. :clock1:

Maya S: Got it.

Ben L: On it.

Sam T: Will post the prompt in this thread in ~5, linking to the test harness repo.
